chunks: Sufficient is Allah and His Word as perfection.
ai.seo_question: What does it mean that Allah and His Word are sufficient for the God-conscious?
ai.summary: In *Kamal al-Din*, Shaykh al-Saduq presents this creedal statement as a foundational pillar of Shia theology, emphasizing that divine guidance through the Qur'an and the Ahl al-Bayt renders external authorities unnecessary for the spiritual perfection of the *muttaqin*. This assertion underscores the Shia belief in the completeness (*kammal*) of the religion and the sufficiency of the Imamate as the living interpretation of Allah's Word. It serves to validate the Shia claim that the path to salvation is fully preserved within the divine revelation and its designated custodians.
